map.在浏览器中用 MediaRecorder 录音，常见约束为采样率 44100Hz: Recording in the browser with MediaRecorder, the common constraints are 44100Hz or 48000Hz sample rate, mono or stereo. With a WebM/Opus container a bitrate around 128kbps is enough for speech. "Export original file" keeps the recorded WebM/MP4 codec; "Export WAV" first decodes through AudioContext, renders offline through OfflineAudioContext with the current gain and playbackRate, then encodes 16-bit PCM - giving an uncompressed WAV, but it cannot restore detail already lost to Opus compression. Before recording, use the live level meter to confirm the peak stays below 0dBFS to avoid clipping.
map.为什么有时录出来有杂音或爆音？: Why does the recording sometimes have noise or clicks?
map.多为输入增益过高导致削波，或环境回授产生啸叫。可先降低麦克风增益、离声源 15~: Usually input gain is too high and causes clipping, or the environment feeds back and produces howling. Lower the microphone gain, stay 15~30cm from the sound source and record in a quiet room; local browser processing never uploads audio, so privacy stays under your control.
map.WebM/Opus 体积小、适合网络传输与即时分享；WAV 为未压缩 PCM，适: WebM/Opus is compact and suits network transfer and quick sharing; WAV is uncompressed PCM, suited to editing software or a DAW. This page's "Export WAV" re-encodes after offline rendering with the current volume and playback speed, so you get the processed result directly, but it cannot restore detail already lost to Opus compression.
